attribution: Planet textures and active ocean masks: Solar System Scope / INOVE (CC BY 4.0). Active night-light imagery: NASA Black Marble 2016.
notes: All textures are local files. Runtime must not fetch any source URL.
Solar System Scope maps are based on NASA imagery/elevation, adjusted for display, with fictional gap fills where mapping is incomplete.
Downloads were obtained from version-pinned npm archives because direct origin downloads were unavailable in this environment. No npm package code was executed or integrated.

2026-10-11: legacy earth_specular.jpg is retired from active builds due to incomplete original provenance; use earth_specular_sss.jpg. Historical rollback assets are not cleared for public source redistribution.
